literal_meaning: শত শত টুকরো বা ছেঁড়া কাঁথা (hundred pieces or torn quilt)
figurative_meaning_en: completely torn; fragmented; torn in many places
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার জীবন এখন শতকুটি কাঁথার মতো ছিন্নভিন্ন হয়ে গেছে।
এই পুরনো বইটি শতকুটি কাঁথার মতো ছেঁড়া।
example_sentences_in_english: His life is now as fragmented as a hundred-piece torn quilt.
This old book is torn like a quilt in a hundred places.
history: The idiom draws from the traditional Bengali kantha (quilt), handmade from recycled sarees and fabrics in rural households, symbolizing wear and tear over time.
note: Often used to describe something thoroughly damaged or dilapidated.
